summary: The approved ordered four-slice decomposition remains bounded and correct. Bootstrap.client.luau and InitializationRunner.luau remain Expected read-only authority inputs and are not in SLICE-001 editable_paths, so RBX2-PROJ-002 does not expand Engineering write authority. No observed scope or requirement blocker requires a replacement slice list.
